0022600042.text: The Clippers (2-8, 13th in the West) host the Oklahoma City Thunder (8-3, 5th in the West) in the 11th game of the Clippers' season, and they come in on a one-game losing streak with a 2-3 home record and a 0-5 road mark. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while Cam Christie is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision. Oklahoma City is missing Ajay Mitchell (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), and Thomas Sorber (knee), and the Clippers trail the season series 0-1 after losing 108-101 in Oklahoma City, following a 0-3 series sweep by the Thunder in 2025-26.
